**Review the receiving operator’s returned work.** The maintained [Operating Plan Return engine](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/74ec0c02b875973ca2371c1704e26eccd16544f0/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/discovery/operating-plan-return.mjs) compares the shared plan history, current local content and incoming work. A named reviewer resolves conflicting values using the current, incoming, original or explicitly entered choice, then applies that reviewed result through the same plan engine. If the current plan has advanced, the operator preserves the returned source and prepares a comparison against the actual latest history. Source captures received from another workspace remain attributable to their originating workspace and observation time.

**Deliver a whole procedure and reopen it independently.** Complete procedure JSON carries the original plan, all carried file bytes, capture identities, request history and full returned-work reviews. The readable HTML includes the complete editable record; original plan JSON and HTML use the maintained generic format and renderer. Explicit receiving in a separate private Runtime workspace retains the original procedure identity and records its receiving request. A later divergent edition returns through the review path. Receiving a procedure starts no installation, application or imported worker and does not restore an external runtime home. The [typed native procedure contract](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/74ec0c02b875973ca2371c1704e26eccd16544f0/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/runtime-workspace/operating-procedures.d.mts), [existing Runtime CLI extension](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/74ec0c02b875973ca2371c1704e26eccd16544f0/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/runtime-workspace/operating-procedures-cli.mjs) and [installed source contribution](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/74ec0c02b875973ca2371c1704e26eccd16544f0/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/contributions/runtime-operating-procedures.json) expose the same complete operating workflow and original engine dependencies.

**Operate the full procedure receiving course with its retained case.** The [manual native course](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/74ec0c02b875973ca2371c1704e26eccd16544f0/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/runtime-workspace/receiving/RUNTIME_PROCEDURES_RECEIVE.md) uses the actual Runtime model and installed CLI with the original and two independent receiving workspaces. It carries a complete selected source file, attributed observations, exact request replay, a conflicting returned plan, both file editions, incoming source captures, complete JSON/HTML handovers and a cold CLI reopen. Its [source-owned programme](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/74ec0c02b875973ca2371c1704e26eccd16544f0/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/runtime-workspace/receiving/RUNTIME_PROCEDURES_RECEIVE.mjs) retains its case directory, action IDs, complete requests, per-attempt logs and results. The pure original-engine receiving check and static source checks are recorded separately; the native API/CLI outcome remains pending until this same manual course returns its actual result. The browser source belongs to the installed application and its existing full customer receiving course; this native entry alone does not claim desktop or phone execution.

**Use the procedure in the existing funded handover.** The resource-integration work records the selected service, exact inputs and required whole output; authority/handover names the operating and receiving roles and retains their reviewed decisions. Production recovery can return the restored service’s actual observations and the next maintainer’s completed steps to the original procedure. These are maintained source capabilities available for the existing customer operation. Source review and dependency checks do not claim that the new procedure workflow has completed a native customer journey. Actual operating outcomes will be joined to the same retained Runtime course and original customer work; this addition does not change the six funded packages, USD 38,000 request, 400 prospective hours, 150-day programme or purchase criteria.

**Return the whole editable operating record.** Associate an actual purchase only through its original buyer deployment, intent, transaction and useful-output evidence. The calendar stages the selected plan and associations into the existing Cohort review; planned entries begin with unverified transfer and unknown accepted-output status. The operator reviews the original evidence before any result can qualify. Reopening a saved Installation displays its original context and report; later missing, changed or voided source and purchase records appear separately. JSON, CSV and iCalendar exports retain the selected edition. Complete case export and independent receiving preserve the plan, source selection, all Installation editions and original business records so another operator can save the next edition.

**Receive the operator’s observations and review the next Installation edition.** The complete [Installation return product, PR573](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/573) lets a receiving operator return named observations against the original Installation. The owner compares those observations with the current criteria, makes explicit KEEP or APPLY choices, and confirms the next original edition. If the criteria have changed, the owner must review the changed basis before applying the return. The receiver’s report, the owner’s choices and the retained Installation editions travel with the complete operating record. This makes the second operator’s correction and acceptance work part of the existing customer workflow.

**Completed whole-product receiving.** The original team-operated walkthrough `SCF-INSTALLATION-RETURN-COMPLETE-CURRENT-7108-20261012` finished with `COMPLETE`. The original model and CLI exercised all three editions, exact-request replay, independent import and closed-workspace reopening. The following complete receiving also operated the typed HTTP and MCP interfaces, six full case exports, the managed Page at desktop 1360 and phone 390 widths, and saved Installation revision 3. JavaScript errors were empty. Both original workspaces were retained, and the actual managed instance reported `OWNED_ORIGINAL_SERVICE_CLOSED` with code 0. The [merged complete runner, PR664](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/664), at `cda82cef181fd92eaa552a5e46c0394b506cfb75`, preserves the original product and runs the same model, Page, typed-client and MCP journey.

**Complete delivery for the receiving engineer.** The 188-member customer package contains the actual completed operating delivery, with the original core and Page archives and both working states. Its exact filename is `Installation_Return_Complete_Receiving_20261012.zip`, size 10,783,641 bytes and SHA-256 `4fb6dfe4f1c1f67ef79fcd251887aee5a3850ebb0eeb47fa5477d0f99d2230d4`. The [complete runnable source and guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/commons-ship-enforcer/tree/de8b03eaeca97e88c26e23f98cdfc20ac96bc096/source-receiving/installation-return-current-7108-20261012) retain all 268 source files and the complete original input. A subsequent engineer continues the saved Installation and its existing request history, then receives and reviews an actual later return; a repeated completed request remains the same operation.

**Use in the funded customer handover.** T1 authority/handover applies this working return mechanism to the selected customer’s actual criteria, responsible operator and source/terms decisions. T3 recovery/handover receives the restored service and the new maintainer’s observations, resolves the owner’s explicit choices and retains the accepted next edition. The current walkthrough is completed development evidence. It does not establish an independent customer’s acceptance, a new paid purchase or mainnet deployment. Its remaining customer configuration and receiving effort stays within the existing six packages, 400 prospective hours, USD 38,000 and 150-day programme.

**Completed Calendar operation.** The October 12 native run `customer-use-calendar-26b1-20261012` received the original operating-case archive at its actual version 37, retained its eight existing recorded testnet purchases and associated two records with their original selected buyers. It saved a twenty-entry plan, then a second edition with nineteen active entries after one cancellation; it also prepared the thirty-request and two-prepaid-group comparisons. The original Cohort seed kept transfer verification false and accepted output unknown. Native CLI and authenticated HTTP exports completed, and independent case receiving preserved both editions before saving and reopening edition three. The run created zero purchases and made zero provider requests. These eight retained case records remain a separate evidence scope from the application's eighteen team-operated development purchases. The [merged source and operating guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/c912e6ecb56a1f049901401d71f98be6cfd5dbb1/stellar/scf_2026/sf47_budget_model/workspace/CUSTOMER_USE_CALENDAR.md) retain the complete procedure; the private receiving package retains the original record identities and source bytes.

**Commission and accept a useful independent service.** The commissioning payer selects the useful resource, its source rights, the required output and the customer application that will receive it. The workorder identifies the merchant, independent buyer operator, maintainer and host/service-cost owner; it records the period or population, units, schema, complete output, price and selected payment terms. The reviewed product plan turns that requirement into a concrete installation and native receiving task. Acceptance follows one approved request through its actual transfer to the complete usable output, then has the receiving engineer reopen the same state and continue a later useful period. A payer can commission the installation and maintainable handover while an independent buyer separately purchases the resource. Later hosting, support and upgrades use the named operating responsibilities and separately agreed scope.

**Apply the foundation within the existing six packages.** These maintained workflows are the pre-award starting product. T1 resource integration adapts the selected source and customer output to the agreed service; T1 authority and handover connects its actual roles and a second accountable operator. T2 provider/ledger deployment and threat response implement the selected independent facilitators, monitoring and recovery behavior. T3 mainnet rollout and production recovery carry the deployed service into recurring independent use, receiving-host restore and support. Each remaining change is assigned once to its original package or a separately commissioned workorder. The grant retains $38,000, 400 prospective hours, 150 days and its original independent-use acceptance targets.

### Deliver each recurring task as a complete customer package

The installed [Collections customer-delivery workspace](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/collections/delivery/OPERATOR.md) completes the handover after the buyer's existing request has produced its retained result. The operator selects an existing collection or opens a complete received InboxTask by its original directory and task digest. The maintained task reader verifies the plan, manifest, task and every expected original file before listing selectable responses. A reporting firm can deliver a month's retained source responses to the analyst who commissioned the work, and an application maintainer can receive them into a separate installation. The saved request-plan and dated buyer work above still determine what should be purchased.

The [original output-selection workspace](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/collections/delivery/model.mjs) binds the customer package to that reviewed preview and the complete selected application source. The named preparation retains its exact request before publication. Returning after an uncertain response continues that same selection; a changed preview is presented as changed work rather than silently replacing the retained package. The browser's pending request is shared through a transaction that prevents another tab from overwriting an unread original operation. A completed preparation is reopened by its original identity.

The [complete package writer and receiver](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/collections/delivery/format.mjs) preserve every selected original response as bytes, with its filename and content identity. They also retain the captured job and configuration identities, original source records, request and output observations, readable JSON and offline HTML reviews, and the complete selected application source. Receiving checks the declared file population, complete lengths and content hashes before accepting the finished package. A small summary or a link to an unretained response is insufficient to complete this handover.

The original Collections route can explicitly package an incomplete selection when the customer needs its actual partial state. The [received InboxTask producer](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/collections/delivery/inbox-task.mjs) requires complete verified responses for every selected request. Its task and plan identities remain in the customer manifest and saved history. Where the original task selects a later settled recovery read, the package separately retains the original attempt outcome and the recovered response's observation time, HTTP status and settlement binding. An earlier uncertain payment observation remains visible beside the complete later output.

A customer receives the original package through the authenticated local workspace or command line. The [customer browser and saved-package history](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/collections/delivery/public/app.mjs) let the recipient reopen the selected package after reload, discover it from a fresh browser, download individual complete responses or download the unchanged full package again. Opening verifies the original archive and every received member. History retains the Collection or InboxTask origin, and resuming the saved preparation preserves the recipient's prior selection and other stored browser fields. The complete selected application source accompanies the outputs for maintenance; installed dependencies and host credentials continue through the normal receiving installation.

### Let the customer's agent receive the same original output

The [registered MCP customer-delivery interface](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/7d8e70f7150b23b1f33ac4c416facdc484c3d624/stellar-forge/mcp-paid-agent/COLLECTION_DELIVERY.md) exposes the same original Collection or received InboxTask through the installed native workspace and Collections receiver. A host operator registers the existing listener under a local name. A task sender binds the complete retained task packet, its original digest and the complete selected application source, including when the original listener is in receiving mode. The recipient registers its own receiving workspace. The agent selects those reviewed names and task identities; packet paths, connection details and credential values remain in the private host configuration.

The [original registered controller](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/7d8e70f7150b23b1f33ac4c416facdc484c3d624/stellar-forge/mcp-paid-agent/native-collection-delivery.mjs) lets the agent inspect the selected task and original intents, review complete responses, retain the exact preview request and prepare that same named customer package. The original task reader and producer validate the complete response and source selection. A returning recipient can discover its own saved history, identify the original Collection or InboxTask, inspect the complete received package and download it again without the sender's delivery ID. Registration borrows the original listener and retains its normal authentication, request identity, mutation ownership and shutdown. The original buyer and collection continue to own purchase, settlement, cancellation and paid-request recovery.

The download keeps separate identities for the saved preview, transfer manifest, complete package, member manifest and each original file. The durable client resumes the same selected transfer and verifies the full final bytes. Recipient history retains its first discovery observation while later receipts can arrive; the selected original receipt must still match. An upload resumes from the recipient's actual saved offset and seals the complete file before explicit receiving. After every listener and MCP owner has closed, a downloaded package reopens offline under its original workspace alias and sender or recipient origin. A different alias is rejected before its saved checkpoint changes. Lost replies reuse the same retained request, package and output selection.

The [installed contribution](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/contributions/collection-customer-delivery.json) places the browser, original CLI, typed client, durable file transport, MCP registrations and operating guides in the existing product distribution. The receiving engineer selects the actual source package and its normal runtime preparation. The same complete source inventory is checked against the executing application and travels with the customer output.

### Commission the whole customer journey in the existing operation

The complete [browser receiving course](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b14a45d2acd498864e0df86b91a5caab844f48c2/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf88-operator-buyer-cli/collections/delivery/receiving/receive.mjs) accepts the original Collections instance or a complete received InboxTask, its already-retained request identities, the selected application source and the installed browser. It operates task inspection and reviewed preparation, loses the reply after the original preparation completes, reloads the saved request, and continues that same request. It downloads the whole package, receives it in a separate customer workspace, checks the full original response and origin-specific history, restores the selected package after reload, discovers it from a fresh browser, and downloads the same full archive. The [combined browser/MCP course](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/7d8e70f7150b23b1f33ac4c416facdc484c3d624/stellar-forge/mcp-paid-agent/native-collection-delivery-receiving.mjs) accepts the same original Collection or InboxTask. It composes browser receiving with registered task inspection and preparation, interrupted sender download and recipient upload, full original response reading, independent receiving and closure of the original listeners. The reopened recipient then discovers its saved history, resumes a full-package download, closes MCP, reopens that download offline and independently receives those same original bytes.

The original customer product and registered MCP composition were merged in PR1140 and PR1197. Recipient history is merged in PR1195; the complete InboxTask producer, validator, browser, CLI and extended receiving programme are merged in PR1238. All twelve PR1238 files were independently read back from the merged source. The source execution used the actual retained 26-member task archive and complete 191,397-byte recovered response, preserving the original uncertain attempt separately. The full browser source also completed task inspection, reviewed preparation and exact pending-request continuation in the V8 browser-contract exercise. PR1278 adds recipient discovery and full-package reuse; PR1304 composes the original task-specific host, client, command line and complete receiving programme with that merged source. All eight PR1304 files were independently read back from the merged destination. F8C1 continues the complete installed customer/browser course with that same original task, retained request and saved operation; its actual outcome will update this paragraph.

The combined source execution exercised trusted task registration through an existing receiving listener, remote path rejection, original task inspection after listener closure, sanitized saved requests and complete response transfer into recipient history and full download. It preserved the earlier uncertain payment observation and later recovered output separately. Same-alias offline reopen passed; wrong aliases, mixed origins and missing checkpoints rejected without replacing the saved identity. These source-level executions use virtual file and listener adapters. The installed browser/MCP course continues in F8C1's existing actual operation with its retained task, request and runtime. Packaging and receiving reuse those outputs without dispatching another provider request.

For funded delivery, the customer names the useful question or recurring report, its authorized source period, the required complete files, the application or agent that receives them, and the accountable receiving engineer. The existing resource-integration package adapts those source and output contracts. The authority/handover package binds the local host registrations and receiving roles. The production-recovery package commissions interruption recovery, full customer restoration and the next maintainer's return to the same work. The other funded packages retain their existing responsibilities. Completed reusable package, interface and recovery source is pre-award work; remaining customer adaptation is assigned once within the six funded packages or a separately commissioned workorder. The grant remains USD 38,000 for 400 prospective hours over 150 days, with its original independent-use and useful-purchase criteria. Package exports, retries, downloads and customer receiving are never counted as additional purchases.

## Geospatial commissioning: a useful parcel decision and a complete receiving application

**The customer task.** Urban3's [published Pittsburgh case](https://www.urbanthree.com/case-study/pittsburgh-pa/) describes the difficulty of establishing which public entities own which parcels and resolving conflicts across municipal datasets. Its [Public Asset Valuation service](https://www.urbanthree.com/services/public-asset-valuation/) uses a portfolio view to support development scenarios and public-asset decisions. Our proposed contribution is the reproducible data preparation and analyst handover that supports that work: retain the original sources, reconcile parcel identities and owner assertions, record the responsible entity explicitly, and deliver a reviewed portfolio and native map. Urban3 would retain its valuation methods, scenarios, professional conclusions and client decisions.

**Worked source and current delivery.** The original Pittsburgh preparation contains 32 exact parcel keys, 29 City eProperty records, nine City tax-register records, 30 County assessment records and 29 parcel geometries. The native importer joined all 97 source records and preserved the unmatched keys. Each source file remains unchanged and carries its publisher and capture identity. The County response keeps its 87 original fields; the geometry source keeps the publisher's owner and tax-agent fields and its explicit EPSG:4326 response. The full 12,587-key City selection is a separate ongoing acquisition using those same source families. The complete [22-file parcel contribution](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/public-commons-sprint-2026/pull/2416), operating guide, native receiving programme and browser programme are merged. The delivered complete product includes the editable software, installable QGIS plugin and nine original input files. Independent source review and native intake preparation are complete; the original full operator/browser/native-map programme is the next receiving result for this case.

**Operate the whole task.** Staff select the received source edition, inspect coverage and competing assertions, and review a parcel's original provider record beside its current decision. They can save a named accountable entity and retain its earlier versions, prepare a complete decision batch, review its exact preview, and save the selected decisions. A portfolio records the selected keys, assessment basis, area basis and grouping. Its complete JSON, parcel CSV and summary CSV retain the original tax year and as-of date; missing values remain explicit. Later source editions show added, removed, changed and unchanged parcel facts. Staff can carry unchanged reviews while retaining earlier frozen portfolios. The reviewed geometry and portfolio feed the existing native QGIS layer and project workflow. Full receiving carries source files, decisions, entity versions, portfolios, map resources, software and operating history so the next engineer can continue the same case.

**Agree the commercial and payment unit.** The original proposed Urban3 workshare is USD 7,200 over twelve active business days after written scope agreement, kickoff and the selected inputs. It covers one jurisdiction, up to 15,000 keys, four source families, an initial edition and one refresh, one correction and a 90-minute handover. This is the proposed implementation scope in the original company case. The selected grant installation separately names the commissioning payer, accountable merchant, independent buyer and receiving engineer. It defines a useful purchased unit, such as a reviewed dataset/asset selection or one complete commissioned report/project release. Public source access and professional valuation remain governed by their original terms; the selected merchant price applies to the agreed service and delivery.

**Connect that unit to Stellar.** For imagery and source datasets, the existing STAC merchant and native Dataset/Object buyers carry the reviewed request, immutable source edition, selected asset files and total cap through the original payment and complete receiving. For an agreed complete project file, the [original approved-order and paid-file workflow](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/public-commons-sprint-2026/blob/cc40a8fe0ca5f9f23956746ed730f8a0a4554a06/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf101-merchant-receiver/CHECKOUT.md) binds the actual file to its order, original settlement event and entitlement. The receiving engineer verifies the same delivered archive before importing it through the QGIS receiver. The customer gets its actual analysis input or maintained project; the merchant retains its original payment, fulfillment and support records. A later agreed source edition or a distinct customer analysis supplies repeat use with its own reviewed request.

**Apply the existing six funded packages.** T1 merchant-resource integration maps the selected customer's source/runtime, useful priced unit and typed receiving application; T1 authority and handover handles its actual source/terms changes and independent engineer access. T2 provider and ledger deployment runs the same useful service through both independently operated facilitators; T2 deployed threat response handles an interrupted settled purchase and a delivery failure with the original financial and file state. T3 mainnet rollout deploys the selected service and recurring consumer; T3 production recovery and handover carries the complete installation, restoration and maintained customer result. These are customer-specific Stellar adaptations of the delivered foundation within the existing USD 38,000, 400-hour and 150-day plan. The application's original independent-operator, purchase-window and returning-use definitions determine the funded cohort measurements.

Original source and proposed commissioning case · Complete product handoff · Same native receiving operation

## Connected Systems observations: customer commissioning and repeat use

A civil or environmental operator needs a defensible observation result that another analyst can use. The useful task begins with named systems and datastreams, a time window, the source's returned schema and a receiving application. It ends with the agreed population, original units and quality fields, a reviewed mapping, and a saved edition or query that the customer can reopen. A later observation period, source correction or distinct analytical request supplies repeat work.

GeoRobotix's [published engineering needs](https://georobotix.us/jobs/) include Connected Systems APIs and sensor-data integration. The original workshare proposes one such customer installation for **$9,600, 72 engineering hours and 12 active business days**, with **$4,800 at commencement and $4,800 at accepted handover**. The first offer was sent to GeoRobotix on October 13, 2026 at 00:05:31 UTC. Its active-day delivery starts after the source selection, access and receiving environment are ready. The customer installation remains a proposed commission on those original terms.

### The customer operation and responsibilities

Under this proposal, the commissioning payer funds the integration. GeoRobotix retains its platform and customer relationship. The customer's technical owner supplies the approved endpoint, authentication reference, source rights and permitted retention, selected systems/datastreams and receiving environment. Its accepting operator agrees the useful queries and checks the delivered result. The implementation engineer configures and adapts the maintained product, corrects in-scope defects, packages it and completes handover. The proposal allows approximately three to five hours of customer participation for selection, review and receiving.

The operator starts with the actual returned JSON schema and raw response. Acquisition retains every acquired page, request and continuation, and records whether the selected window is exhausted, capped or failed. A configured bound does not establish complete history. Original numbers remain lexically intact; a numeric analytical projection is a reviewed mapping choice. The mapping carries source identifiers, timestamps, missing versus null values, units and quality fields into the edition.

The customer reviews that edition, runs the agreed query, and compares later editions using selected keys and duplicate handling. The package contains original source, mappings, configuration, saved results and the operating guide. A second engineer imports it into a separate workspace, reopens the result, reproduces the exact export and continues the same acquisition or review. External result links remain linked metadata; binary/video decoding and additional source families require separate scope.

### What has actually operated

The [complete product](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/646) and its [selected installation guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/8883afe8b26545340db5d85e230cd1266af3c56e/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/selections/CONNECTED_SYSTEMS.md) are shipped. The original native operation completed schema and source review, an edition, query and export, independent import and exact re-export, and cold reopen. Its input is the publisher's [committed one-observation example](https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogcapi-connected-systems/blob/fb858be23aa03e2b824ec50b5a97ac2c2a1d3fec/api/part2/openapi/examples/observations/obs-simple.json), including the original 23.5 temperature value. It demonstrates the receiving workflow; it is not a live sensor collection or a customer deployment. Fifteen actual public endpoint error responses are retained separately.

The original GeoRobotix commercial workorder has also completed its native case → editable plan → saved scope → independent receiving and cold reopen. The completed 63-member Workshare package retains the full source, receiving packet, eight-phase plan, operating guide and original verified sent-contact journal; its saved scope is `scope-26c23cc23e91c36ac55b86c1`. The maintained [Python Installation intake](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/edefd19d9516c793de90759d0f747fc3b0ffebea/stellar/scf_2026/sf47_budget_model/workspace/workshare_intake.py) has now received that same case, scope, plan and eight phase identities with the complete packet present and source files unchanged. The shipped [Customer Installation programme](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/4dea5f17698a7842f6007f95de46b73c0bd48092/stellar/scf_2026/sf49_data_commissioning/installation-workorders/GEOROBOTIX_CSAPI.md) carries the original dependencies, hours, milestones and receiving decisions into the proposed commissioning work. Its eight customer engineering workorders remain planned. The selected observation product archive is built; the next acceptance stages are completion of dependency installation, installed-runtime receiving and browser acceptance.

### Twelve active business days to an accepted installation

The delivery starts after the parties agree access, selection, receiving environment and commencement payment. Provider or customer waiting time is recorded separately from active delivery days.

|Active days|Engineering hours|Complete output and acceptance|
|  ---  |  ---  |  ---  |
|1|6|Agree the actual response/schema, permitted selection and retention, receiving environment and useful acceptance queries.|
|2–4|18|Operate paged acquisition with original responses, explicit bounds, continuation, restart and provider-error handling.|
|5–6|12|Review field, time, unit and quality meanings; approve the mapping and first complete selected edition.|
|7|6|Run the agreed useful queries and compare editions while retaining their original source meanings.|
|8–9|12|Complete the customer's operator flow for selection, acquisition, mapping, editions, queries and recovery.|
|10|6|Install on the receiving host; import and reopen the same source, configuration and results.|
|11|6|Close the consolidated in-scope review; finalize source, notices, configuration and operator handover.|
|12|6|Complete the walkthrough and acceptance: the customer queries, compares and continues the retained operation.|
|**Total**|**72**|**One agreed JSON observation source and a complete receiving application.**|


Acceptance checks the declared window, received counts, duplicates and quality observations against the agreed source population. The operator must distinguish exhausted coverage from a capped or failed collection and must be able to reopen the original mapping and continue the retained operation. One consolidated review and in-scope defect correction are included. Additional endpoint families, changed outputs or wider integration receive a written scope, price and schedule before work begins. Hosting and provider charges are borne by the agreed party separately.

### Revenue, capacity and the proposed programme

The fixed fee pays for a defined installation and handover. It does not imply a platform subscription, a purchased dataset, payment principal or collected revenue. The fixed fee implies $133.33 per planned delivery hour. At the application's common **$95/hour planning rate**, 72 hours represent **$6,840** of effort and leave **$2,760** before other costs. A 25% effort overrun raises the modeled effort to 90 hours / $8,550 and leaves $1,050. These are planning comparisons, not actual payroll costs or a profit forecast. Actual effort, corrections, customer participation, invoices and collections remain in the original workorder and forecast.

Twelve active days average six engineering hours a day. The resulting 30-hour five-day workload cannot also occupy the same contributor's grant allocation. Bryce must assign actual available contributors and dates once across the commercial and funded work. The two proposed payments remain uncollected scenario cash until actual receipts exist.

If this candidate is selected as one of the two independent services, T1 completes its remaining merchant resource, buyer receiving and source-change authority; T2 deploys the same useful service through both independent facilitators and operates settlement/delivery recovery; T3 completes mainnet configuration, returning buyer work and receiving-host recovery. These changes remain within the existing six funded packages. Already completed engineering and separately paid customer work are excluded from the grant estimate or reconciled once before commitment, consistent with the [future-development funding rules](https://stellar.gitbook.io/scf-handbook/scf-awards/build-award/budget-and-deliverable-guidelines).

The merchant and buyer must agree the actual paid unit: a complete selected edition, a distinct saved query or another explicit resource. Paid pages, where applicable, retain their original prices and complete-task cost. A later useful observation period or query can count toward the existing cohort only after the original approval, observed native transfer and complete accepted result. The illustrative native example, a source archive, an installation retry and a prepared proposal add no qualifying purchase.

### Prepare, review and create the next briefing

The [Customer receiving and report renewal](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/e5380c046370b58c350d16a35b48b13bf91cd510/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/partners/open-meteo-operations/REPORT_RENEWAL.md) guide continues the original Open-Meteo operation. Use **Sites & requests** to retain the required original captures. In **Frozen reports**, select the previous briefing and choose **Prepare next edition**.

For each decision, select the full source capture and UTC reporting window. The source choice retains the requested coordinates, source family, selected grid cell and elevation and must supply the requested variable; a model change is displayed. The current working rule supplies its variable, unit, aggregation, threshold and coverage requirement. An explicit shift changes elapsed hours; the operator selects the intended start and end rather than relying on a local calendar or daylight-saving interpretation.

Use **Review complete next edition** to compare the prior and next thresholds, member coverage, aggregates, windows, working rules, source models and grid selections. Choose the actual disposition for each decision. **Create reviewed edition** commits the decision revisions and report together. Repeating an accepted commit opens that same report.

Retained source acquisition and retrieval time remain distinct from model initialization. Ensemble member fractions retain their original meaning, and the median uses the eligible member aggregates selected by the reporting rule. The reviewed report preserves the inputs and interpretation needed by its receiving operator.

The [source-owned renewal contribution](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/e5380c046370b58c350d16a35b48b13bf91cd510/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/contributions/open-meteo-report-renewal.json) exposes the same typed renewal interface alongside the original weather command. The CLI offers `renewal-choices`, `renewal-review` and `renewal-commit`; commit selects the digest returned by the complete review.

### Deliver the editable report and receive it independently

Export the reviewed report as its complete handover and ZIP. The renewal ZIP retains the report, HTML, decisions, source JSON, complete CSV and editable weather package with its history. The original receiving limits are 48 MiB for the handover and 32 MiB for the ZIP; the full editable package carries a larger retained history.

Initialize the independent review workspace, review the complete incoming handover and receive the exact reviewed package. The original CLI follows `review-init`, `handover-review` and `handover-receive --expected-sha` with the digest returned by that review. The receiving team can inspect the previous report and renewed decisions and continue its next authorized briefing from that state.

For commissioning, agree the reporting task, source and windows, working rules, accountable reviewer, required output and recurring cadence. The implementation fee covers the configured working service and handover. The selected merchant report retains its resource and purchase terms. Useful recurrence comes from the next required briefing and its reviewed source, decisions and output.

The report-renewal implementation is [merged in the installed Merchant Workspace](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/818), composing editable receiving, the original archive programme and the browser's unit and source-selection corrections. The original operating programme carries this same report through renewal, repeat commit, complete export, independent receiving and reopening.

### Apply the original six packages

T1 binds the customer's source and rules, report output, service configuration and receiving operator. T2 joins the agreed complete briefing to the existing merchant, buyer, facilitator and settlement workflow and recovers its original paid delivery. T3 commissions the production reporting cadence, returning buyer operation and complete maintainer handover. The grant's existing hours, funding and customer-use windows govern these selected adaptations.

## CanadaBuys qualification, bid decisions and complete customer receiving

A supplier or procurement adviser can commission a working qualification desk around the tender editions it actually uses. Staff retain the official notices, the company's capability statement, solicitation documents, supplier evidence and reviewed requirements in the same workspace. The result is a saved Bid, No bid, Investigate or Park decision with a usable report, named next actions and an editable handover for the receiving team.

### Open the delivered application

The [complete Bidder Desk operating guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/3bed4c455063ce18cf24ee50cebdc47b89f35825/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/canadabuys/BIDDER_DESK.md) covers the existing procurement workspace, browser, HTTP client, CLI and merchant provider. The [complete merged customer delivery](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/795) includes all 37 application files, three saved workspaces, seven selected or complete receiving editions and the original native programme.

From the delivered archive, start the original service and open its printed local address:

```sh
node application-source/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/canadabuys/cli.mjs serve \
  --workspace "$PWD/working-delivery/workspaces/cold" \
  --operator "Delivery team"
```

Choose **Bidder desk**, then **Decision & reports**. The delivered case opens its received decision revision 4 with the source edition, evidence, requirements, history and next actions. The direct local route is **/bidder-desk**. The same SQLite workspace supplies the procurement and bidder pages.

### Carry a real procurement decision through the whole workflow

First import the governing official source and select the actual notice. Its original bilingual row, reference and solicitation numbers, closing field, linked documents and retained editions remain available. Save the company's capabilities, commodity-code families, delivery regions, qualifications, supporting documents, preparation time and commercial preferences as an explicit profile. **Check profile fit** exposes the original notice value and profile revision behind each match, gap or unknown.

Retain the solicitation, amendments and supplier evidence with their actual file bodies or recorded source/access state. Each assessment selects the exact saved document edition and page or section. A requirement retains its original clause, classification, applicability, source evidence, supplier evidence, reviewer and assessment. Later document changes remain visible alongside the edition used for the original review.

The operator selects the notice edition and company profile, records one of the four decisions, and uses **Review selected context** before saving. The model binds the saved decision to the complete reviewed context within the same transaction. A source, profile, evidence or requirement change calls for a fresh context review. Named actions retain stable identities, owners, due times and their open, done or cancelled state.

**Compare saved decision with current records** shows complete before and after values and the reasons for reassessment. A later comparison leaves the original decision available. Selected HTML, JSON and CSV reports carry the reviewed decision, source fields, profile, fit findings, requirements, evidence references, actions and changes. The standalone HTML is the reading copy; the full workspace package is the editable receiving material.

### Complete receiving and subsequent work

Receive the selected notice or complete workspace through the existing **Sources & handoffs** page, CLI, typed client or merchant tools. The package includes its original CSV bodies, earlier record editions, exact evidence files and saved command results. The native receiver reuses matching history, appends consistent new editions and retains a receiving team's later local work. An unchanged command retry returns its original saved result.

A separate receiving team can open the delivered complete package using a new workspace directory:

```sh
node application-source/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/canadabuys/cli.mjs receive \
  --workspace "$PWD/received-procurement" \
  --file "$PWD/working-delivery/packages/complete-cold-workspace.json" \
  --expected-revision 0
```

The original delivery completed all 17 native and browser phases, including independent receiving and cold reopening. Its five retained desktop, historical and 390-pixel captures were inspected. The worked supplier, amendment and decision cases retain their labelled input and the full 67-column tender and 80-column award rows used in that operation. The customer installation selects its own governing source editions and real company evidence through this same application.

### Commissioning and the existing funded programme

The workorder names the paying supplier or adviser, its source coverage, the qualified reviewer, the receiving team, the complete report or editable package and the agreed correction and support work. A later amendment, changed company evidence or a distinct notice creates useful follow-on review. The original merchant integration carries a selected complete dataset or decision output through the existing publication and buyer receiving flow.

T1 configures the customer's actual source, company profile, service terms and receiving application and trains a second operator. T2 completes the agreed priced output through the existing buyer, facilitator and ledger operations and recovers an interrupted delivery in that same case. T3 commissions the production service, returning customer task, retained source/history and independent maintainer handover. These adaptations use the existing six-package allocation and its original independent-use criteria.

### Receive the complete original document set

A procurement adviser usually receives a solicitation, pricing workbook and several amendments together. The [complete document-intake workflow](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/e25ee1acf25fdc88c724a1ad8ab9d1f9f5b5d644/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/canadabuys/EVIDENCE_INTAKE.md) carries that set into the same selected notice. In **Documents & evidence → Import a document set**, the operator chooses the original files, previews their exact bytes and records each document's actual type, publisher edition, source and issued date. A later file selects its earlier document only when it actually supersedes that edition.

The operator prepares one complete request before saving. It retains every original file and can be downloaded for recovery. The whole set commits through the existing SQLite evidence transaction; each document becomes an ordinary evidence record with its original bytes, SHA-256 and saved edition. A changed transaction revision can be explicitly refreshed without changing the intake's original file identities. A repeated completed request returns the original editions.

Every newly imported document starts **UNREVIEWED**. The assigned reviewer reads the actual clauses and workbook before recording an assessment, supplier evidence or decision. An amendment remains distinct from the document edition used for an earlier review. Original evidence, per-document commands and decision references travel in the complete workspace package. This gives the receiving adviser the source needed to continue the procurement work.

### Give the customer the installed operating workflow

The [installed customer guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/b3c52362c64027ba5744c5a459432eb7aeede9b7/stellar-forge/mcp-merchant-operator/CANADABUYS_CUSTOMER.md) supplies the existing `canadabuys-customer` command, typed client, original MCP tool catalogue and full file-receiving operation. The customer selects its existing authenticated endpoint, operator-provided workspace alias and credential environment reference, then binds that alias to the observed native workspace UUID. A later alias change cannot silently select another workspace.

The customer can read all retained pages at one workspace revision, prepare an exact company-profile or decision request, inspect it and enter it through the original provider. The saved operation keeps its exact arguments and native command ID. If a response is lost, continuation follows that operation's actual replay contract. An unresolved export retains its original request; the operator can select and verify the already-created publication instead of exporting another copy.

Full report and package delivery uses the provider's existing file inspection, bounded reads and reader release. The original relative filenames, byte counts, hashes and publication identity remain in the retained download. A stopped transfer resumes its verified file prefix; an expired reader is reopened against the same complete file. Offline verification needs no endpoint credentials. The native package receiver opens the full customer workspace and preserves its original evidence, saved records, history and later local work.

The receiving operator opens that editable workspace through the installed application:

canadabuys serve \
  --workspace canadabuys-customer-work/received-workspace \

```

Use its printed loopback URL, then **Bidder desk → Decision & reports**. The installed customer source and complete thirteen-stage receiving programme are merged. ### Carry the actual commercial Workshare into the funded Installation

The [native Workshare-to-Installation guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/243533c2bbdc2bffc108d8087e04811f2e3bbe7d/stellar/scf_2026/sf49_data_commissioning/installation-workorders/CANADABUYS_NATIVE_WORKSHARES.md) joins procurement delivery to the existing Grant Operations case. Commercial facts and commissioning choices have separate origins. The responsible operator supplies the actual customer/supplier relationship and its basis, working-day commitment and start conditions, and the complete delivery-phase mapping. A partner name does not establish a payer. A recorded agreement status does not establish collected payment.

Each original milestone is assigned once. The complete mapped milestone amounts equal the original fee, and phase production and partner hours separately equal their original quoted totals. Phase owners, inputs, deliverables, acceptance and dependencies remain explicit; the dependency graph must fit the selected working-day duration. CAD amounts remain CAD. The source intake does not convert those amounts into the existing USD forecast.

The installed preparer retains five complete files: the original native package, explicit source selection, normalized native Workshares, Installation receiving input and preparation report. The [Source Desk workflow](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/243533c2bbdc2bffc108d8087e04811f2e3bbe7d/stellar/scf_2026/sf47_budget_model/workspace/INSTALLATION_SOURCE_DESK.md) verifies those exact five outputs and creates one complete source ZIP:

starforge grant-installation-workorder canadabuys package \

  --out /absolute/private/canadabuys-source-delivery/CanadaBuys_Source.zip \

```

In the actual authorized Grant case, open **Installations → Prepare original source workshares**, retain that ZIP and choose **Receive native CanadaBuys source**. Review the selected native edition, complete history, original row, parties, cents, effort and phase allocation. The original request journal retains the incoming archive and all prepared files. Attach the actual native commissioning document and original application package through the existing atomic source transaction, then open the editable Installation preparation.

The original task, source, merchant and buyer deployment, payment and receiving fields remain selections in that Installation. Optional bindings come from the exact attached preparation and must agree with the fresh seed identity. Missing real selections may remain pending. A later native Workshare edition supplies a new complete source preparation, preserving earlier source history and the existing Installation's operated selections.

### Demonstrate a useful service and record its actual outcome

The customer adoption sequence gives each existing funded stage a concrete procurement task:

A file download, source import or repeated command does not establish another customer purchase. A source preparation does not establish a saved Installation. The present evidence has three distinct states. The original Bidder Desk application completed seventeen native/browser phases and five visual reviews. The installed customer, complete document intake and native Installation/Source Desk joins are merged implementations with complete operating guides and source review. The existing case owner selects that continuation; this chapter creates no case, plan, payer, payment or native execution result.

## Document processing and complete customer receiving

A report publisher, agency or analyst can commission a document service that carries the customer's editable input through a paid rendering job into a complete reusable delivery. The maintained Document merchant joins supplier configuration, Stellar payment terms, customer Requests, Jobs, document output and receiving in the original application. The customer receives the PDF together with the source and the information needed to relate it to the original request.

### Configure and operate the saved merchant

The [Document merchant Applications guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a514c7f22b8c4fc969f72a6d47e8228bc876c3c6/products/document-merchant/APPLICATIONS.md) describes the installed workflow delivered in [Merchant PR813](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/pull/813). Select the actual MintPDF, snaplab or PDFMint supplier, its account plan, supported source formats, queue and worker limits. The editable setup retains the merchant's public HTTPS origin, native asset, recipient and amount. The operating host's private environment supplies the actual provider key and payment-factory configuration.

In the existing Runtime Workspace, open **Applications**, select **Document merchant**, and choose the original document directory, complete setup, native payment factory and private environment. Review the seller, customer and private operator listeners, the original worker and any configured completed-result delivery. Use **Review**, **Save**, **Review Start** and **Start**. The saved application receives the original authenticated Jobs announcement and opens the selected Jobs, Input receiving, Job resolution or Result delivery page.

The document directory retains its original setup and merchant state. A newly reviewed directory is prepared on first start; an existing directory reopens its retained merchant. The generic Paid-job merchant application and Document merchant refer to that same underlying resource when they select the same merchant-state directory. The published HTTPS origin remains the customer entry point.

### Fulfill and receive the whole customer document

Export the merchant's complete customer setup:

```sh
document-merchant customer-setup \
  --directory /absolute/private/document-service \
  --out /absolute/private/document-customer-setup.json
```

The customer opens its existing **Request** application, loads that origin, selects `renderHtml` or the supported `renderMarkdown` function, and supplies the complete editable source file, title and original task reference. The request and native checkout retain that exact input and advertised one-document price. After the original purchase settles, the configured worker calls the selected supplier and produces the complete delivery.

|Delivered slot|What the receiving customer gets|
|  ---  |  ---  |
|PDF|The complete binary document.pdf.|
|Source|The unchanged UTF-8 HTML or Markdown submitted for that document.|
|Request|Complete source and rendering-request metadata, including the original task reference.|
|Render|The actual supplier response metadata and resulting document identity.|


The customer's existing resource library receives all four files. Multi-document batches use the same original Requests, checkouts, Jobs and complete Collection export. Their saved batch operation continues an accepted request through recovery and receiving. In the Commons customer workflow, the rendered Lead Pack uses the saved HTML edition and attaches its PDF to the original Case Desk delivery, preserving that case and edition.

### Prepare complete customer data and templates

The installed composition workflow starts from the customer's entire CSV or JSON dataset and editable HTML or Markdown templates. It maps named fields, groups line items where the source represents an order across several rows, and can generate an invoice plus an optional greeting card under one parent task reference. A reporting recipe can produce a complete report for each selected customer or period. The [composition operating guide](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a887ac9d56b1a0933bf1060bf70bd74ee25c6d16/products/document-merchant/COMPOSITION.md) includes complete JSON orders, grouped CSV orders and Markdown reports with their original input files and mappings.

The saved source plan retains the complete dataset, templates, recipe and every generated document. The customer can inspect a working page and download the full original files. Exact source selection continues into the [original document batch](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a887ac9d56b1a0933bf1060bf70bd74ee25c6d16/products/document-merchant/batch.mjs), whose existing Request preparation obtains the merchant's actual native price before execution. The plan groups amounts by their network, asset, recipient and payment flow. One selected parent task can contain several independently priced document requests.

### Operate Document production in the original customer workspace

In the installed Applications catalogue, **Document production** opens that same customer's existing Request, Checkout, Jobs and Resource library, adding the complete document workspace at `/documents/`. Its selection retains the original private customer-options file, nested Checkout/operator configuration, allowed source directory, provider and actual merchant origin. The [managed service](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a887ac9d56b1a0933bf1060bf70bd74ee25c6d16/products/document-merchant/composition-service.mjs) reads the original customer's launch and owns the same customer lifetime as the generic Job checkout application.

The customer uploads every complete dataset and template file, reviews the generated document and parent-task counts, and chooses **Prepare merchant price**. **Render at this saved price** executes the exact original native plan. **Receive existing jobs** continues already accepted work. The [document customer workspace](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a887ac9d56b1a0933bf1060bf70bd74ee25c6d16/products/document-merchant/composition-workspace.mjs) keeps source preparation, original paid execution, full receiving and customer export connected to those same saved records. A reopened browser resumes from the original source plan and native batch.

The original resource download route returns the full binary PDF for each received document. A portable Collection includes the PDFs, unchanged sources, original requests and renderer results; the composition handover adds the full dataset, templates and recipe. An interrupted export continues its original destination, and a later customer edition retains its own complete output. Stopping the application closes admission, drains document work, and then closes the customer's original controllers and state owner.

### Deliver ordered invoice and report bundles

A merchant's customer can require both the individual documents and a complete nightly bundle. The same document product now carries that remaining fulfillment step: select the fully received PDFs in the required business order, preserve every original file, review the assembly merchant's actual native price, receive all merged volumes and hand over one complete customer archive. The [installed ordered-bundle workflow](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a514c7f22b8c4fc969f72a6d47e8228bc876c3c6/products/document-merchant/ASSEMBLY.md) is available through the existing Document production browser and `document-merchant assemble`.

PDFMint's optional `assemblePdfs` function uses its [original merge endpoint](https://pdf.mintapis.com/docs#merge), checked on 13 October 2026. The merchant selects a complete native price for one merged volume. The [source and original batch integration](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/adae6d07971165fc04da3391440b786cf59ef6c4/products/document-merchant/assembly.mjs) divides the complete ordered source by the documented 50-file and measured encoded-request limits. A volume with one PDF retains its exact original bytes without a supplier merge or new native purchase. For a nightly invoice task, individual render requests and any assembly requests remain separately priced operations under that same parent task.

The customer archive contains every final PDF volume, a readable index, CSV results, every original PDF in the editable source plan and the unchanged original paid-job Resource Collection. Receiving and interruption recovery continue the original customer requests and jobs. The supplier's one successful merge credit, number of source PDFs, PDF pages, native purchase count and whole customer-task acceptance retain distinct units. This extends the document service's existing customer commissioning and maintenance work within the same six funded packages.

### Maintain the service and continue customer work

Supplier consumption and the merchant's customer price have their own recorded basis. **Price** review uses the saved supplier plan and native payment terms; **Usage** reads the supplier's actual account endpoint and saves its complete response. A 25-document planning review can use `document-merchant price --directory /absolute/private/document-service --documents 25 --supplier-units 25`. The selected account plan and returned usage determine the operating allowance.

**Stop** closes admission on the original listeners, drains the worker and configured delivery dispatcher, and releases the merchant state. **Review Start** and **Start** then reopen the same saved application, retained requests, completed files and eligible jobs. Interrupted setup continues from its retained setup and generated files. A supplier authentication or allowance failure remains attached to its original job; after the account issue is corrected, the operator uses that job's existing resolution or retry action.

Receive the completed immutable document-product distribution into the existing Runtime Workspace and reopen Applications to load its current catalogue. For customer commissioning, operate the actual merchant factory and customer workspace: start the managed service, fulfill the selected original HTML or Markdown through the existing batch, receive all four files, attach the output to its original task, and reopen the same completed job after stopping and restarting the application.

### Receive PDFs from existing customer systems

The same customer browser accepts complete invoices, reports and other PDFs that already exist. The operator selects their business order, saves every original byte, reviews the assembly merchant’s actual native quote and receives each resulting volume through the original paid batch. This supports nightly invoice packs and customer report bundles even when another application produced the documents. Complete source plans can also be received from the customer’s declared local file roots, and interrupted saving or export resumes its original source and destination.

The delivered bundle includes every final PDF, all original sources, the readable volume index and the original native Collection. One-file volumes remain unchanged. Original documents, paid merge requests, supplier credits, PDF pages and accepted parent tasks continue to have separate counts. This is an additional customer intake of the same document service within the existing service-adaptation packages and merchant adoption targets.

### Continue an existing merchant installation

An existing native buyer account can commission the document service using its original operator profile and facilitator policy, or an HTTP commerce installation can use its retained original setup. The [complete commissioning workflow](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a514c7f22b8c4fc969f72a6d47e8228bc876c3c6/products/document-merchant/COMMISSIONING.md) selects the complete document payment terms within the actual account policy, preserves the configured asset, recipient and payment flow, and reuses the original payer, operator budget and native facilitator. The original profile retains the payer, signer and spending-ledger identity. When commissioning from a prepared commerce installation, its selected native offer supplies the service configuration. Each new customer document has its own original Request, Checkout and Jobs identity under the actual business task.

For a PDFMint service, that same commissioning can include an explicit assembly payment within the original account policy. It preserves the separate rendering and merge-volume prices while sharing one original facilitator and managed service. The customer browser can render new documents and assemble existing PDFs against that commissioned origin; each batch still uses its actual original quote.

The same preparation creates the complete document application and private customer options, including the existing nested operator configuration and allowed source roots. In the existing Document merchant Applications entry, the operator selects this complete private commissioning setup, reviews its original account and source, then uses Start, Open, Stop and reopen on that same saved merchant. First Start prepares the reviewed installation; its native service and facilitator share the original lifetime. It also supplies the direct settings for the installed customer browser and the existing Case Desk PDF receiving flow. A saved customer HTML edition can therefore proceed through its actual merchant quote, native payment, complete PDF/source receipt and attachment to the original case item while retaining its source link. Closing the service drains the original Jobs owner before releasing the native facilitator's signer ownership. Subsequent service starts reuse that merchant state and customer history.

This commissioning arm connects the delivered document product to an existing merchant's operating setup within the same funded service-adaptation work. Completed customer operations retain the original parent-task, native-purchase, supplier-unit and PDF-page distinctions.

### Commissioning within the existing funded work

The workorder specifies the paying organization, allowed input formats, required document output, actual supplier account, native merchant resource and price, receiving application, delivery destination and support responsibility. Initial implementation configures that useful service and hands it to a second operator. A subsequent customer document or explicitly selected batch creates the next billable task under its advertised terms.

T1 maps the customer's input, supplier, merchant output and receiving application and completes operator handover. T2 carries the agreed original document through buyer intent, facilitator and ledger operations and resolves an interrupted paid delivery in that same customer task. T3 commissions the production service, returning customer work, retained editable source, complete receiving and independent maintenance. These adaptations use the original six funded packages, hours and customer-use windows.

### Customer acceptance and source units

Stellar's [x402 Exact payment flow](https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/agentic-payments/x402/built-on-stellar) supplies native authorization and settlement for the selected token transfer. The application separately binds the customer's full source, approved native plan, original request and complete received result. That retained operation supports payment recovery and original result receiving in the customer's existing application.

Customer acceptance follows the whole requested business task. An invoice and greeting card can be two paid requests for one order, while a multipage report remains one document request. Supplier render credits, cache behaviour, PDF pages, native purchases and parent-task completion retain separate units. The [installed supplier contract](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace/blob/a887ac9d56b1a0933bf1060bf70bd74ee25c6d16/products/document-merchant/contracts.mjs) preserves each provider's original inputs, settings and usage definitions. Prepaid allowance consumption retains the application's existing counting rules.

The funded outcome remains two independent merchants and two independent buyers. T2 requires at least 10 useful testnet purchases in total across both buyers during seven consecutive days ending by day 90. T3 requires at least 30 useful mainnet purchases in total during fourteen consecutive days ending by day 150, with both buyers returning on another UTC day for a distinct completed purchase. Both merchants receive independent use. Document commissioning, onboarding and ongoing operation fit the same USD 38,000, 400 prospective hours at USD 95 per hour, and 150-day schedule.

Provider documentation was checked on 12 October 2026: [MintPDF OpenAPI](https://mintpdf.dev/openapi.json), [snaplab documentation](https://snaplab.dev/docs) and [PDFMint documentation](https://pdf.mintapis.com/docs). These are distinct provider accounts and contracts; their actual account responses govern allowance and capacity when the merchant fulfils the customer's document request.

## Custom API commissioning and complete dataset receiving

An implementation partner needs a custom API source to become a maintained customer data service. The useful delivery includes the selected records, their schema and update meaning, a committed destination, an operator who can continue the next reporting window, and a second engineer who can reopen the whole project. The Airbyte commissioning application supplies that foundation through the original Python CDK and one persistent native workspace.

### Operated product and original source

The complete OpenFEMA commissioning run finished on October 12 using Python 3.12.14 and Airbyte CDK 7.35.0. Its thirteen native operations retained forty-four original files and completed source specification and discovery, acknowledged incremental extraction and continuation, full comparison, portable project export and independent receiving. The original operation also completed dataset export, inspection and identical-request replay. The saved project is a871de52-5256-453e-b0c7-fe568b8c4685. Its complete portable workspace contains 517,895 bytes; the complete native source/result package contains 644,420 bytes, and the resulting dataset delivery contains 96,334 bytes.

The worked source is FEMA’s published Disaster Declarations Summaries API. The retained selection fixes the source request, original record identities, namespace, field contract, update window, paging and lookback behavior. The maintained CDK executes the actual requests and produces its original protocol output. The source declaration, selected configuration, discovered and configured catalogues, records, emitted state, destination acknowledgments, decisions and operation history remain associated with the same project.

The operator provides configuration and source editions, stream and schema selection, complete record browsing, state and protocol inspection, comparison, recovery, destination handover and complete editable export. Browser, command-line, HTTP, SDK and MCP interfaces use that original workspace. Complete dataset receiving follows native keyset positions so a customer can receive a full population without repeatedly counting and scanning its earlier pages; the operator also retains ordinary page navigation. The dataset publisher reads committed records and retains the exact schema, source meaning and original handover identity.

### State, interruption and a receiving engineer

The application keeps source progress and committed destination progress distinct. A source STATE becomes eligible for the next sync only after the destination acknowledges the preceding committed records and echoes that same source state. A completed end-of-file commit can retain records without inventing a new source checkpoint. The existing local destination supports append and an explicitly selected full-refresh overwrite. Incremental overwrite is rejected. Late changes and overlap retain their original record and state meaning; the customer’s deduplication and deletion policy is agreed in the selected source contract.

When a command is interrupted, the operator reopens its retained original request, protocol and destination result. It reconciles that operation before choosing a permitted continuation. Complete receiving preserves pending historical operations while distinguishing the actually running worker, so restoring an archive does not automatically run unrelated saved commands. A receiving engineer obtains the complete workspace and source, reopens the accepted result, inspects the full record and checkpoint population, and can make a later authorized change while an exact replay continues to return its original result.

The source includes managed Applications registration and receiving over this same saved project. Source selection, installation identity, Python/runtime bindings, native ownership and the original ready record travel together. The maintained Applications correction keeps a connection in its connecting state until adoption has finished, then reviews the completed binding before Start. Native lock acquisition now runs asynchronously, preserves the original kernel lock and returns the actual child-process outcome; this keeps status and readiness observation responsive while ownership remains enforced.

### Commissioning scope and accountable roles

The original MetaOps workshare proposes a fixed **USD12,000, eighty-hour, fifteen-active-business-day** commissioning unit. It selects one client organization and authorized HTTP/JSON API, one tenant, up to three named streams, one parent-child level and a nominated receiver. Its commissioned population is the complete agreed initial interval plus two following windows. MetaOps retains its client relationship, architecture, source access and production release. The implementing engineer delivers the connector adaptation, initial and following populations, native operator, agreed destination route, source and second-engineer handover.

The five allocations are twelve hours for source and receiving agreement; twenty-four for connector adaptation and the initial complete population; sixteen for incremental continuation, interruption and reviewed changes; sixteen for the operator and selected customer destination; and twelve for independent receiving and handover. Two consolidated correction rounds and one staff handover are included. Eight correction hours are already distributed within the eighty-hour estimate. The original proposed payment stages are USD3,600 at agreed commencement, USD4,800 after accepted first destination and incremental-continuation review, and USD3,600 after accepted complete independent handover. The written start agreement sets actual dates and review windows; source, provider and customer waiting does not consume active engineering days.

The intake records the exact stream and namespace identities, primary keys, cursor type and precision, history interval, lookback and late-change behavior, deletion policy, expected volume, source rights, authentication references and destination acknowledgment contract. If an existing supported customer warehouse is selected at commencement, its own native commit and query result becomes part of acceptance alongside the retained source and local commissioning result. The approved source and destination choices determine the implementation work and the complete result the customer receives.
